meta.title: 86 Board
meta.description: A one-tap availability board for WooCommerce: mark a menu item, service, or product 86'd the moment it runs out, no wp-admin required.
meta.author: Alex Kirk

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Product_Simple' ) ) {
	return;
}

$menu = array(
	'Appetizers' => array(
		array(
			'name'      => 'Garlic Bread',
			'price'     => 6,
			'available' => true,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'Caesar Salad',
			'price'     => 9,
			'available' => true,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'Calamari',
			'price'     => 12,
			'available' => false,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'Soup of the Day',
			'price'     => 7,
			'available' => true,
		),
	),
	'Mains'      => array(
		array(
			'name'      => 'Grilled Salmon',
			'price'     => 24,
			'available' => false,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'Margherita Pizza',
			'price'     => 16,
			'available' => true,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'Ribeye Steak',
			'price'     => 32,
			'available' => true,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'Mushroom Risotto',
			'price'     => 18,
			'available' => true,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'Fish and Chips',
			'price'     => 17,
			'available' => true,
		),
	),
	'Desserts'   => array(
		array(
			'name'      => 'Tiramisu',
			'price'     => 8,
			'available' => true,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'Chocolate Lava Cake',
			'price'     => 9,
			'available' => true,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'Cheesecake',
			'price'     => 8,
			'available' => true,
		),
	),
	'Drinks'     => array(
		array(
			'name'      => 'House Red Wine',
			'price'     => 9,
			'available' => true,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'House White Wine',
			'price'     => 9,
			'available' => true,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'Craft Lager',
			'price'     => 7,
			'available' => true,
		),
		array(
			'name'      => 'Sparkling Water',
			'price'     => 4,
			'available' => true,
		),
	),
);

foreach ( $menu as $category_name => $items ) {
	$term = term_exists( $category_name, 'product_cat' );
	if ( ! $term ) {
		$term = wp_insert_term( $category_name, 'product_cat' );
	}
	if ( is_wp_error( $term ) ) {
		continue;
	}
	$term_id = is_array( $term ) ? (int) $term['term_id'] : (int) $term;

	foreach ( $items as $item ) {
		$product = new WC_Product_Simple();
		$product->set_name( $item['name'] );
		$product->set_regular_price( (string) $item['price'] );
		$product->set_status( 'publish' );
		$product->set_catalog_visibility( 'visible' );
		$product->set_manage_stock( false );
		$product->set_stock_status( $item['available'] ? 'instock' : 'outofstock' );
		$product->set_category_ids( array( $term_id ) );
		$product->save();
	}
}
